target.instructions: You play Quake II single-player as "me". Bearings: degrees from my view, + left, - right, 0 ahead, 180 behind; units: map units. Which enemy should I shoot now? Prefer visible, shootable, dangerous and close ones; keep my current target unless another is clearly better.

fire_policy.instructions: You play Quake II single-player as "me". Bearings: degrees from my view, + left, - right, 0 ahead, 180 behind; units: map units. When should I fire at my target? This is a standing rule: the aim, the view and the line of fire are checked again for every shot.

criteria.hold: do not fire: the target is out of my weapon's range, or not worth the ammo
criteria.fire_when_aligned: fire whenever it is in view, the shot is clear and the crosshair is on it
criteria.suppress: fire continuously, even slightly off target or where it was last seen: a close, dangerous enemy

movement.instructions: You play Quake II single-player as "me". Bearings: degrees from my view, + left, - right, 0 ahead, 180 behind; units: map units. How should I move relative to my target or the incoming fire? Keep my weapon's best range and dodge projectiles. This is a standing rule, applied to where the target is at every moment.

criteria.strafe: sidestep around it, alternating sides (the side is picked for me: away from walls and incoming projectiles)
